rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the result or outcome caused by something.

example.english: The effect of this decision was something nobody expected.
example.traditional: 呢個決定最後嘅結果，大家都估唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 zeoi3 hau6 ge3 git3 gwo2 daai6 gaa1 dou1 gu2 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this for the influence one thing has on another, especially in everyday explanations.

example.english: The effect of not getting enough sleep can be seen in your energy the next day.
example.traditional: 瞓得唔夠會影響第二日嘅精神。
example.jyutping: fan3 dak1 m4 gau3 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 dai6 ji6 jat6 ge3 zing1 san4

rows.note: Use this for an impression or produced effect, including a technical effect when the context makes the meaning clear.

example.english: The effect of this filter looks quite natural, so it does not seem fake.
example.traditional: 呢個濾鏡嘅效果幾自然，唔會令人覺得假。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 leoi6 geng3 ge3 haau6 gwo2 gei2 zi6 jin4 m4 wui5 ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 gaa2

rows.note: Use this specifically for an alteration or added effect in recorded or amplified sound.

example.english: The explosion scene gets a particularly powerful effect from the sound design.
example.traditional: 套戲嘅音效喺爆炸嗰幕特別有震撼力。
example.jyutping: tou3 hei3 ge3 jam1 haau6 hai2 baau3 zaa3 go2 mok6 dak6 bit6 jau5 zan3 ham6 lik6
